findings.location: AD-4 lines 286-292; data-model.md relationship state table lines 155-162; grounded-chat-v2.md lines 77-87; chat-evidence-packet-v2.schema.json relationships definition lines 109-126
findings.affected_requirement: FR-014 through FR-020 and SC-001 through SC-003
findings.evidence: Accepted Story 12.4 explicitly makes DocumentEdgeId a many-decisions-to-one-REFERENCES-Edge foreign key and states that any number of distinct exact decisions may share the same document Edge (specs/013-exact-cross-repository-flow-pass2/data-model.md lines 68-78; plan.md lines 195-205; exact-resolution-and-flow-planning.md lines 100-118). The corrected Story 12.5 plan instead requires exactly one accepted v2 decision per Cross-Repository Edge and classifies multiple exact decisions as present-inconsistent. Its packet relationship also carries only one exactDecisionId while Edge deduplication is by Edge ID. A fully valid accepted Story 12.4 Edge with two endpoint or consumer-entry decisions would therefore be excluded, or implementation would have to impose an undisclosed uniqueness change on Story 12.4.
findings.correction_outcome: Define a deterministic edge-authority projection that preserves Story 12.4 many-to-one decision cardinality without mutating its contract. Specify whether the packet binds a canonical complete ordered decision set or a canonical selected valid decision while treating other independently valid decisions as non-conflicting; align relationship and Flow Group packet/currentness shapes, ordering, fingerprinting, and state tables. Add a B2 architectural RED for two current exact decisions sharing one Edge, including distinct Published Flow Groups, and prove stable inclusion/currentness without legacy authority or primary-packet mutation.

findings.location: AD-2 line 255; data-model.md ChatRetrievalRequest and AuthorizedChatSnapshot sections lines 20-34 and 83-100; grounded-chat-v2.md line 60; Tier 1 B1 strategy line 432
findings.affected_requirement: FR-012, FR-023 through FR-025, SC-002 and SC-005
findings.evidence: The accepted specification requires fallback over current Business Logic summaries and advisory-context terms. The corrected plan repeats that mandatory behavior and fingerprints/bounds advisory context, but ChatRetrievalRequest has no advisory-context field, AuthorizedChatSnapshot names no authorized context source, and no coordinator/repository seam owns loading, normalization, scope/currentness checks, or transfer of those terms into lexical fallback. Current production retrieval passes an empty advisory string. The B1 test strategy names only an insufficient-fallback result and no positive advisory-context vector. Tasks generated from this plan could either silently omit a mandatory fallback or read an unbounded/unowned context source, so the behavior is neither feasible nor testable at the disclosed typed path.
findings.correction_outcome: Name the existing authoritative server-owned advisory-context source or explicitly define the bounded empty-context disposition. Add the provider-independent typed field/stage that carries it, its authorization/currentness owner, NFC/tokenization and exact 8,192-byte handling, its precise fallback scoring role, and positive/negative/exact-plus-one public-seam tests. Ensure the canonical packet fingerprint binds exactly the context actually used and that callers cannot inject it.

Keep Track C attestation as a projection over both immutable sources and retain the cross-artifact vocabulary test.

summary: REVISE. The review was pinned to clean commit 080d04e04e1334ffc4176149110cadee9d0d2d79 and compared the corrected plan boundary against rollback commit 73c317f10917236e7a4ac0ad55f4966abd18024e. Checks included Git identity/status, SHA-256 artifact binding, nonrecursive binary diff hashing, JSON parsing, placeholder scan, FR/SC trace inspection, exact current Prepared Chat control-flow tracing, Story 12.4 decision/Edge/Flow Group cardinality tracing, packet/currentness/streaming contract comparison, and planned-change policy review; tasks.md was intentionally excluded as stale. The single typed lexical-primary cutover, explicit old-path deletion, deterministic 256/12/min(3,count) rules, B1-B4 seams, no-migration boundary, strict raw streaming, accepted-only reveal, release schema 2.2, and Track B/Track C telemetry split are directionally sound, but two High plan defects remain: current-v2 relationship authority conflicts with accepted Story 12.4 many-to-one decision cardinality, and mandatory advisory-context fallback has no authorized typed source or positive test seam. The Agent-tool planned-change trigger remains YES; Scan-strategy and PRD-conflict triggers remain NO. Because the verdict is REVISE, no authorization request or task generation may occur. If a corrected plan later receives ACCEPT, fresh planned-change authorization is still required before regenerated tasks because the retrieval-tool and provider-dispatch architecture changed.
